What are the DevOps course fees in Pune? DevOps course fees vary based on DevOps syllabus, DevOps certification, and practical training. Understanding DevOps pricing helps you choose the right program with better ROI. A well-structured course with hands-on projects and career support can significantly improve your DevOps career opportunities in the DevOps field. Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri April 1, 2026 5:52 pm Starting a career in DevOps requires not just the right skills but also a clear understanding of course investment. DevOps certification fees can vary based on training quality, tools covered, and practical exposure offered by institutes. When exploring a DevOps course in Pune , it’s important to evaluate the overall value offered. The fees may differ based on exam and training inclusions. Additionally, DevOps pricing often depends on course level, duration, and the hands-on experience provided. Choosing wisely ensures better career growth and ROI. How much does a DevOps course cost in Pune? DevOps course fees in Pune typically range between ₹15,000 to ₹40,000 for standard training programmes, while advanced or certification-based courses can go up to ₹60,000+ depending on features and placement support. Key Insights: Basic courses: ₹15,000–₹25,000 (limited support) Certification courses: ₹30,000–₹65,000 (with exam & placement) Pune-specific training: ₹15,000–₹40,000 (1–4 months duration) Certification exams (AWS, CKA, Docker): ₹10,000–₹40,000 Unlock the Secrets to a Powerful LinkedIn Profile ! Download Free e-Guide What factors affect DevOps course fees across different institutes? Here are the key factors that influence DevOps course fees across institutes, along with what learners should look for: DevOps Course Syllabus Coverage: A well-structured devops course syllabus with tools like Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud platforms usually impacts the overall fee, as more comprehensive training adds greater career value. Certification & DevOps Certification Cost: The devops certification cost may vary depending on whether certification exams and preparation are included or charged separately. Learning Format & DevOps Classes Near Me: Classroom-based devops classes near me may have slightly higher fees due to infrastructure and in-person support, while online options can be more flexible. Institute Quality & Best DevOps Training Institute in Pune: Choosing the best devops training institute in pune often means access to experienced trainers, updated tools, and structured learning, which can influence pricing. Hands-on Training & Practical Exposure: Courses that include real-time projects, cloud labs, and practical assignments generally offer better skill development and justify higher fees. Career Support & Guidance: Institutes that provide interview preparation, resume building, and placement assistance add extra value to the overall learning experience. What are the top DevOps career opportunities available in Pune? Role Key Responsibilities Average Salary (Pune) Demand Insight DevOps Engineer Build CI/CD pipelines, automate deployments, manage infrastructure ₹6–12 LPA (entry), ₹8.5L avg High demand across IT & startups ( Indeed ) Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Ensure system reliability, monitoring, incident management ₹10–18 LPA Growing demand due to uptime & scalability needs Cloud DevOps Engineer Work with AWS, Azure, GCP for cloud automation ₹8–16 LPA 65% roles require cloud skills DevSecOps Engineer Integrate security into DevOps pipelines ₹10–20 LPA 35% hiring growth in DevSecOps roles Automation Engineer Automate testing, deployment, and workflows ₹6–14 LPA Strong demand in agile companies Cloud Architect / DevOps Architect Design scalable cloud infrastructure & strategy ₹18–30+ LPA High-paying senior-level role Want to Book A Free Expert Guidance Session?​ Book Now Get Free Career Counseling from Experts ! Email Phone Send How to Choose the Right DevOps Training Institute in Pune Check Industry-Relevant Curriculum: A strong course should include tools like Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud platforms. Around 70% of DevOps roles require hands-on skills in these tools, so DevOps syllabus depth matters most. Focus on Practical Training (Not Just Theory) : Institutes offering real-time projects and 80+ hours of labs prepare you better for interviews compared to basic classroom learning. Evaluate Trainer Experience: Trainers with real industry exposure (5–10+ years) bring practical insights, which helps in understanding real DevOps workflows used in companies. Look for DevOps Certification Support: Good institutes guide you for DevOps certifications like AWS DevOps or Kubernetes, which can improve employability by up to 30%. Placement Assistance & Career Support: Structured support like mock interviews, all about career opportunities , resume building, and referrals plays a key role—top institutes report 80–90% placement assistance. Flexible Learning Options: Weekend, weekday, and online batches are important, especially for working professionals managing time constraints. Compare Value, Not Just DevOps Fees: DevOps training fees in Pune typically range from ₹15,000 to ₹50,000, but the real value comes from hands-on learning, mentorship, and career outcomes—not just pricing. Many learners today focus more on hands-on exposure and teaching quality rather than just placement claims, as real skills matter more in interviews, career opportunities and job performance. What topics are covered in a complete DevOps course syllabus? Module Topics Covered Key Skills Gained Linux & Networking Linux commands, file system, permissions, networking basics System administration, server handling Version Control Git, GitHub, branching, merging Code management & team collaboration CI/CD Tools Jenkins, pipeline creation, automation workflows Build & deployment automation Containerization Docker, images, containers, Docker Hub Application packaging & portability Orchestration Kubernetes, pods, clusters, deployments Managing containers at scale Cloud Platforms AWS / Azure / GCP basics, services, deployment Cloud infrastructure management Infrastructure as Code Terraform, Ansible, configuration management Automated infrastructure setup Monitoring & Logging Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack Performance tracking & troubleshooting Scripting Shell scripting, basic Python Task automation DevSecOps Security tools, best practices Secure deployment pipelines EMI & Payment Options for DevOps Certification Course Easy No-Cost EMI Option: Learners can opt for 0% interest EMI plans, making it easier to manage course fees without financial burden. Flexible Installment Structure: Typically, payment is divided into: Small registration amount (approx. 10%) Major portion after course start (around 70%) Final instalment in later stage (20%) Multiple Payment Modes: Options include online transfer, UPI, card payments, and EMI-based financing for convenience. One-Time Payment Benefits: Students choosing full payment may get access to additional benefits like discounts, priority batch selection, or added learning resources. Value-Added Inclusions: Payment typically covers training, study materials, real-time projects, and placement support – ensuring complete, career-focused learning. FAQs DevOps Course Fees in Pune 1. How much does a DevOps course in Pune cost? The cost of a DevOps course in Pune typically ranges from ₹15,000 to ₹80,000 depending on course level, duration, and included features like projects and placement support. 2. What factors affect DevOps training fees in Pune? Fees depend on the devops course syllabus, trainer experience, hands-on projects, and whether certifications and placement support are included. 3. What is included in the DevOps certification cost? The DevOps certification cost usually covers exam fees, training sessions, study materials, and sometimes cloud lab access for practical learning. 4. Are there affordable DevOps classes near me in Pune? Yes, you can find DevOps classes near me offering flexible pricing, but it’s important to check course quality and practical exposure before enrolling. 5. Why do DevOps pricing plans vary across institutes? DevOps pricing varies based on course depth, tools covered, certification support, and additional services like mock interviews and job assistance. 6. Is investing in a DevOps course worth the cost? Yes, with high demand and salaries, a well-structured DevOps course in Pune offers strong ROI, especially with hands-on training and placement support. 7. Do all institutes include certification in DevOps course fees? Not always. Some include it in the DevOps certification cost, while others may charge exam fees separately. 8. How can I choose the best DevOps training institute in Pune based on fees? Look beyond pricing—compare the syllabus, trainer expertise, and placement support to find the best DevOps training institute in Pune. 9. Are EMI options available for DevOps course fees? Many institutes offer EMI or instalment plans, making DevOps pricing more manageable for students and working professionals. 10. Does a higher DevOps course fee mean better quality? Not necessarily. A higher fee should reflect better curriculum, real-time projects, and career support, not just branding.
